subject: Marine Works - Halifax Harbour and Approaches
text:
Marine Works - Halifax Harbour and Approaches
Marine borehole drilling underway in Wright's Cove, Dartmouth, Nova Scotia. Drilling will take effect Monday to Friday during daylight hours. Eagle Beach barge and Eagle River workboat will be in the area standing by on VHF Channel 12. White floats will be used to indicate drill hole positions. 
Vessels in the area are requested to give a wide berth and minimum wash.
